findings.message: Relative value(s) y: "-=18" on "#mascot-container" start while another writer for the same property is active between 4.80s and 5.10s. Relative tweens capture their base at tween init: the sequential path inits mid-flight of the other writer, a cold render worker landing later inits with its end state, so the same frame renders at two different positions (snap at chunk boundaries).
findings.fixHint: Use absolute values for y, or a fromTo() with explicit endpoints, so every seek path resolves the same state. Single-writer relative values are safe; the conflict is the second writer.
